events.title: Zebra Technologies Beats Q1 Earnings Estimates, Raises 2026 Outlook
events.body: ZBRA tops Q1 estimates as revenues jump 14.3%, driven by broad-based segment growth and a raised full-year earnings outlook.

events.title: MIDD Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Food Processing Strength
events.body: Middleby beats Q1 estimates as Food Processing backlog hit a record $416M, while higher guidance and portfolio changes boosted outlook.

events.title: What to Note Ahead of Plug Power's Q1 Earnings Release?
events.body: PLUG heads into Q1 results with growth in services and hydrogen revenues, but rising costs and forex headwinds may pressure margins.

events.title: AXON Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates on Tariff-Driven Margins
events.body: Axon raises its 2026 revenue outlook after Q1 sales surge 33.7%, fueled by strong demand for TASER 10, body cameras and AI offerings.
